answer: Require every new agent identity to burn a one-time fee whose receipt is a unique on-chain token, and make that fee quadratic in how many identities one backer claims. A Sybil attacker wanting k accounts pays k squared as a ripple of burns, not k flat fees, so doubling the fake army roughly quadruples the bill. Peers confirm each receipt with a fast pulse of checks. No receipt, no access to the shared oasis of work and liquidity.
